# iru_blueprint_library_items (Data Source)

Lists the library items assigned to a blueprint, including items assigned outside Terraform. The API returns only each item's ID and name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everything assigned to a blueprint, including items assigned outside Terraform.
data "iru_blueprint_library_items" "core" {
  blueprint_id = iru_blueprint.core.id
}

output "core_items" {
  value = [for i in data.iru_blueprint_library_items.core.results : i.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blueprint_id` (String) Blueprint ID.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Assigned library items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Library item ID.
- `name` (String) Library item name.
